description: This file defines the FinalExceptionSubscriber class, which handles uncaught exceptions and certain 4xx errors in Drupal, providing last-chance error handling and logging.

classes.name: FinalExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: Handles final exception processing and 4xx error handling in Drupal, implementing EventSubscriberInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the subscriber with a ConfigFactoryInterface.

methods.name: getErrorLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the configured error level, caching it if not already set.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Main handler for uncaught exceptions, generating error responses with optional backtrace.

methods.name: on4xx
methods.description: Handles 4xx HTTP errors that are not caught elsewhere, generating appropriate responses.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event listeners for exception events, with priorities.

methods.name: isErrorLevelVerbose
methods.description: Checks if verbose error reporting is enabled.

methods.name: isErrorDisplayable
methods.description: Wrapper for error_displayable() to determine if an error should be displayed.

methods.name: simplifyFileInError
methods.description: Reduces verbosity of file paths in error messages by removing DRUPAL_ROOT.
